scope: A curated set of public data sources matching TerraScope, not an exhaustive inventory of the internet.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A via Earth Search
datasets.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; preserve source attribution
provides: NDVI, NDRE, NDMI, SAVI and EVI calculated from available bands
datasets.limits: Actual field polygon required for indices. Clouded scenes can be unusable. Health scores are experimental derived indicators, not measured yield.

datasets.name: NASA POWER daily meteorology
datasets.resolution: Gridded daily estimates, not an on-farm weather station
datasets.license: NASA POWER data policy and citation guidance
datasets.limits: Coordinates required. Meteorological availability trails by about 2–3 days; fill values are excluded. Weather at a nearby grid cell is not proof of actual irrigation.

datasets.name: Fields of the World — India boundaries
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; attribute original authors and FTW/Kerner Lab
datasets.limits: Historical benchmark polygons are not the user's farms and are not guaranteed unchanged today. Crop type, current planting/harvest dates and yield are not supplied.

datasets.name: NASA Harvest CropHarvest
datasets.coverage: Global agricultural labels from multiple source datasets
datasets.resolution: Labelled points/polygons with associated remote-sensing time series
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for CropHarvest; check constituent dataset terms
provides: Training/evaluation examples and historical satellite/climate features
datasets.limits: Research training data, not current records for saved fields. Labels, date coverage and polygon availability vary. No automatic import is enabled.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCereal global products
datasets.license: See product-specific license and citation at the provider
datasets.limits: Not a universal crop classifier; it cannot confirm that a saved field currently grows soybean or apple. Historical maps are not current farmer records. No automatic import is enabled.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0; include ESA WorldCover/Copernicus attribution
provides: Cropland, trees, water, built-up and other land-cover classes
Land-cover context for screening demo locations
datasets.limits: Cropland is not an individual crop type or cadastral boundary. Different 2020/2021 algorithms complicate change comparison. No automatic import is enabled.

datasets.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
provides: Soil pH, organic carbon and total nitrogen
datasets.limits: Model estimates do not replace soil tests. REST API is beta with availability limits and a 5-calls/minute fair-use policy. No soil ingestion module is enabled.

datasets.name: UCSB CHIRPS v3 rainfall
datasets.license: See CHC usage and citation guidance
datasets.limits: A separate rainfall product with preliminary/final revisions. Not a drop-in replacement for all NASA weather variables. No automatic import is enabled.

datasets.name: FAO Crop Calendar
datasets.coverage: Selected countries, crops and agroecological zones
datasets.license: See FAO data terms and source citations
datasets.limits: Coverage varies. Typical seasonal windows must not be saved as an individual farm's actual planting or harvest dates. No automatic import is enabled.
